question: The radius of a circle with centre at O is 6 cm and the central angle of a sector is 40°. Find the area of the sector.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle = 6 cm

Central angle of a sector = 40°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fea168c3ab5e31857f96f8b0b1c8d1c9f215c1a320665d138e84f17db68af617.png] 

**Formula used:**

Area of sector = theta over 360° × πr²

**Calculation:**

Area of the given sector = 40° over 360° × π × (6 cm)2 

⇒ (1 over 9× π × 36) cm²

⇒ (π × 4) cm2

⇒ 4π cm2 

∴ **The area of the sector is 4πcm2 .**** **

6
